hero.introText: Specializing in bold branding, custom mascot logos, high-energy esports design, clean sports iconography, and personality-driven 2D character design. I craft impactful visuals that command attention.

about.quote: "A brand identity isn't just about graphics—it's about making a lasting impression that sets you apart from the noise."
about.body: With an education in Communication Design from Arena Multimedia Karachi, I combine strategic conceptual thinking with top-tier digital illustration. Whether structuring character guidelines, developing custom vector assets, or establishing full esports branding architectures, I deliver professional design.

expertise.title: MASCOT LOGOS
expertise.desc: High-impact mascots designed for esports teams, sports franchises, and modern businesses looking to establish a memorable character brand representation.

expertise.title: ESPORTS BRANDING
expertise.desc: Striking and aggressive gaming designs featuring high-energy vector mascots, custom logotypes, jersey mocks, and full streaming overlay packages.

expertise.title: SPORTS ILLUSTRATION
expertise.desc: Bold and dynamic sports logos featuring strong typography, clean outlines, and energetic compositions designed to stand out on uniforms and digital platforms.

expertise.title: 2D CHARACTER DESIGN
expertise.desc: Expressive and personality-driven character designs optimized for digital media, focusing on strong silhouettes, clean vector geometry, and print scalability.

expertise.title: TYPOGRAPHY DESIGN
expertise.desc: Custom lettering structures and typography overlays. Creating bespoke layout hierarchy systems that complement primary illustration works.

expertise.title: BRAND IDENTITIES
expertise.desc: Holistic brand guidelines and social media templates. Designing unified collateral assets (banners, avatars, posts) that ensure a consistent visual message.

portfolio.title: Cyber Fangs Mascot
portfolio.desc: Futuristic cybernetic wolf vector logo designed for a professional esports gaming team, featuring custom neon lighting highlights.

portfolio.title: Samurai Red Panda
portfolio.desc: Personality-driven red panda samurai character mascot, designed with detailed armor gradients and bold vector shapes.

portfolio.title: Chicago Bulls Concept
portfolio.desc: Fierce charging bull mascot logo for sports organizations, showcasing clean dynamic vectors and custom typography layouts.

portfolio.title: Cyber Racer Character
portfolio.desc: Detailed 2D character design of a cyberpunk racer holding key assets, emphasizing clean line execution and strong color highlights.

portfolio.title: Branding Highlights Collage
portfolio.desc: Collage showcasing vector Mascot, Sports and Esports logos designed at Digital Cuberoot (2023 - 2025).

experience.title: GRAPHIC ILLUSTRATOR & DESIGNER
experience.desc: Serving as lead vector designer specializing in character mascot creation, esports team branding, and customized merchandise line design.
tasks: Designed high-impact brand characters and esport mascot logo structures with dynamic shadow details.
Maintained clean vector coordinates across digital and print assets, supporting scalability.
Engineered dynamic letterforms that integrate seamlessly with primary mascot frames.
